(a) Gila's weak face-pair integrals vs the moment series
    wekS/wekE/wekV, intOrd 48 and 64, f = 1 and 1 + 0.1i
    series: momentSeries, BigFloat 256 bits, mMax raised until the last term
    is below 1.0e-20 relative; nTrm = mMax + 2 terms, n = 0 .. mMax + 1

## the 18 entries, their panel pair and its canonPanels sub-code
   panels in the wekGrdPts! frame (gX,gY,gZ) = wekFrm(dir, scl), A = grid
   points 1,2,5,4 = [0,gX] x [0,gY] x {0}; two pairs mean Gila averages them

## series vs Gila
   dRe/dIm are signed deviations of Gila from the series in units of |series|;
   cnv = |d64| < |d48| in both components, brk = d48 and d64 straddle the
   series in the real part, PLATEAU = order 64 no closer than order 48;
   f64ser = Float64 series (Float64 moments) against the BigFloat series
